rationale: AC-3.2 specifies backend-specific behavior regarding .env file reading, while N-000767 establishes a general security constraint that API keys must not be in the child environment of the headless backend; AC-3.2 refines this by clarifying that the anthropic-api backend does read from .env.
quotes: when the anthropic-api backend runs, then the key is read from .env
keys only in the git-ignored `.env`, never in the child environment of the headless backend
